title: Integrate caffeinate into loop runner
description: Call caffeinate.start() before the first loop iteration and caffeinate.stop() in a finally block to ensure it's always cleaned up, regardless of how the loop exits.
acceptanceCriteria: caffeinate process starts when loop starts (on macOS)
caffeinate process is terminated when loop exits (any exit condition)
caffeinate is terminated even if the loop throws an error
No orphan caffeinate processes remain after loop exits

steps.details: Add to loop-runner.ts: `import * as caffeinate from './caffeinate.js'`

steps.description: Start caffeinate before the loop and stop in finally
steps.details: In runLoop, wrap the for loop: `const caffProc = caffeinate.start(); try { for (let i = 1; ...) { ... } } finally { caffeinate.stop(caffProc) }`

steps.description: Verify caffeinate starts and stops correctly
steps.details: On macOS: run rocket loop on a project, then run `pgrep caffeinate` during the loop — should show a process. After the loop exits, run `pgrep caffeinate` again — should return nothing.

technicalNotes: The finally block in an async generator runs when the generator is done OR when the caller breaks out of the for-await-of loop
